about: Maths as the model writes it, delimited or not, mangled or not, and text and code that must stay as it is, with the text each must become. 'tagged' is what repair_reply makes of 'input', with graspy's <latex-inline> and <latex-block> tags, $...$ pairs left alone and every other $ written \$; 'web' is the same text as a client reads it, the tags written as $ and $$, which the web's processLatex must make. 'lesson' is what repair_markdown makes of it when that differs (a lesson's JSON fields also restore doubled backslashes, tag $...$ pairs, keep a list of letters as text and leave a stray $ alone); 'replyOnly' cases are not lesson text. 'vocabulary' is what bare maths may use: the commands, environments, display-only environments, commands that need an argument, and relation and operator commands (infix) are KaTeX's own, written by scripts/generate-math-vocabulary.mjs; the names and the functions (commands a letter after them belongs to) are chosen. Read by apps/server/tests/test_math_repair_corpus.py, apps/web/src/lib/latex.test.ts and apps/server/ui/src/shared/latex.test.ts, so the three cannot drift.
